source_sentence: The study focus was the use of medical procedures in the last month of life among dementia patients in different care locations in Japan.

source_sentence: Of 6,148 patients, 886 (14.4%) had dementia as a primary disease; most received care in the last month of life in nursing homes (48.0%) or hospitals (44.8%) rather than in their own home (7.2%).

source_sentence: Our case suggests that even patients with severe atrophy in the anterior cortex may be able to orient themselves within their neighborhood if their posterior cortex is preserved.
